## What is this feature for?

Deletion supports the right to leave an instance while preserving integrity of shared data that cannot safely cascade away.

## Before you start

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Where can I find it?** | My account → Security → Sensitive area |
| **Access** | User |

## Where can I find it?

Follow this path in the interface : **My account → Security → Sensitive area**.


![Delete your account — desktop screen](/docs/screenshots/account-delete-en-light.png)

![Delete your account — mobile screen](/docs/screenshots/account-delete-en-mobile.png)

*Delete your account — mobile screen*

## How do I use it?

1. Handle or transfer maps still owned.
2. Open Delete account and confirm identity.
3. Read the consequences and confirm permanently.

### Expected result

The last active administrator cannot delete their account.

## How does it work?

- The last active administrator cannot delete their account.
- Personal data is anonymized according to instance policy.
- Account sessions and secrets are invalidated.

## Good to know

:::note
- This action is irreversible.
:::
